تشتوون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَوُونَ (taštawūna) /taʃ.ta.wuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# تُشْتَوَوْنَ (tuštawawna) /tuʃ.ta.waw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
